translations.web: The sin of the young men was very great before Yahweh; for the men despised Yahweh’s offering.
translations.bsb: Thus the sin of these young men was severe in the sight of the LORD, for they were treating the LORD’s offering with contempt.
translations.kjv: Wherefore the sin of the young men was very great before the LORD: for men abhorred the offering of the LORD.
translations.asv: And the sin of the young men was very great before Jehovah; for the men despised the offering of Jehovah.
